title: A Causal Linear Model to Quantify Edge Flow and Edge Unfairness for Unfair Edge Prioritization & Discrimination Removal
reasoning: The paper is fundamentally concerned with the ethical principles of fairness and anti-discrimination. Its primary goal is to develop a technical methodology for identifying, quantifying, and removing unfairness (discrimination) in high-stakes decision-making processes, such as those in the criminal justice system. This work directly operationalizes ethical and legal concepts like 'disparate impact' and 'disparate treatment' into a causal model, making ethics the central motivation and subject of the research, rather than a peripheral consideration.
